blocks.text: 🪝 Indian Navy Launches 'Machilipatnam' ASW Shallow Water Craft & Delivers DSV 'Nipun'. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Machilipatnam (BY 529): Launched 7th of 8 Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Crafts built by Cochin Shipyard Ltd (over 80% indigenous content).
DSV Nipun: Hindustan Shipyard Ltd delivered 2nd Diving Support Vessel capable of Deep Sea Saturation Diving up to 300m depth.
